changelog:
v3.9.1 — Even Smoother Playback

• Recovery now freezes on the current picture instead of cutting to black — a stream hiccup or channel change holds the frame while it reconnects.
• Resume is instant — no more 'Resume or Start Over' pop-up. A new Restart button in the player controls lets you start a movie or episode from the beginning anytime.
• Smoother binge: the last frame holds between episodes instead of a black gap.
• After a brief slowdown, video quality climbs back up on its own instead of staying soft.
